name: sql_query
description: Run SQL queries against a database. Supports SQLite (local), PostgreSQL, and MySQL via connection strings.

connection.description: DB connection string or SQLite file path

manual.overview: Use when you need to run SQL against databases (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Supports connection strings and file paths for SQLite.

input.query: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE active = 1

tips: Use file path for SQLite; connection string for PostgreSQL/MySQL
Always use LIMIT on SELECT to avoid unbounded results
Validate query syntax before running; avoid destructive DROP/DELETE without confirmation
Use parameterized queries for user-supplied values to prevent SQL injection
edge_cases: Connection string format varies by backend; wrong format causes connection failures
Transaction isolation may affect concurrent reads/writes

executor.command: python -c "import sqlite3, json; conn=sqlite3.connect('{{args.connection}}'); conn.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; rows=[dict(r) for r in conn.execute('{{args.query}}').fetchmany({{args.limit}})]; print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2, default=str)); conn.close()"
